description: Builds the USDC transfer of the Check price for the networks chosen (networks, from check_info checkNetworks: perNetwork each, never above maximum) from payer to the analysis fee wallet on chainId (any network of check_info networks), for the payer to sign. The credit is bound to those networks. Needs buyProof, the purchase proof of THIS payer from check_buy_proof (the payer signed and passed the free screening); without it, or with another wallet's, check_buy_proof_required (401). The server also measures the sender on-chain. Returns { check { id, status awaiting_payment, amount, amountRaw, token, feeWallet }, transaction, plan (buildId check-<id>, steps on EVM or transaction on Solana), report }. check.id (CHK-...) is the capability of this Check: whoever holds it reports the payment, analyses and reads the result, so keep it private and keep it to come back to the result. Each call makes a NEW Check, good for 30 minutes (expiresAt): a transaction mined after that is credited by the price of now on the networks it covers (check_report_payment). Pass checkId of one still awaiting payment and in its time to rebuild its transfer (the Solana one expires in about a minute). Sign the transaction exactly as returned: it carries the mark of THIS Check (16 bytes after the transfer arguments on EVM, a memo on Solana). A transfer you build yourself is refused with analysis_payment_rejected reason charge_not_tied after the money left: do not pay again, prove the wallet with destination_challenge (receiver = details.feeWallet, chargeId = the check id, chargeTxHash = that hash) and destination_authorize, then report the same hash again. Refusals: analysis_tool_unavailable (503, a tool is down: nothing is built), check_credit_limit (409), payer_blocked (403), check_network_unsupported (400), check_networks_required (400), check_already_paid (409, checkId of a paid Check), check_charge_expired (409), check_unavailable (503).

buyProof.description: The purchase proof of this payer from check_buy_proof (vcb_..., 10 minutes). Secret.

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

checkId.description: Optional: a Check still awaiting payment, to rebuild its transfer instead of making a new Check.

networks.description: The networks to analyse, from check_info checkNetworks (e.g. ["1","8453","solana-mainnet"]). The price is perNetwork times these, never above maximum.

payer.description: The paying wallet, the one that signs the transfer (0x on EVM, base58 on Solana).

name: check_charge
